title: AI Engineer
note: The advert marks nothing as must-have, preferred or nice to have. requirements.text: 4 or more years of professional software engineering experience
2 or more years building AI, automation or internal tooling in production
Experience building AI agents, tool use, function calling and multi-step workflows
Currently located in the Philippines or Pakistan
Hands-on experience with Claude: the Claude API and at least two of Claude Code, Projects, Skills or MCP connections
Experience with OpenAI or Google Gemini, and selecting the appropriate model
Experience with n8n, Make or Zapier
Experience integrating Google Workspace, Slack, a CRM and project management tools through APIs and webhooks
Solid SQL skills and experience with databases, data pipelines and data warehouses
Excellent communication skills with non-technical stakeholders
Entrepreneurial mindset with strong execution, ownership and measurable-results orientation
